# Language Variety Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageVarietyKind`](gmeow-LanguageVarietyKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageVarietyKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The sociolinguistic classification of a language variety — a value, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. Standpoint-scoped: 'dialect' according to one authority may be 'language' according to another. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LanguageVarietyKind`](gmeow-LanguageVarietyKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
